Unwilling to work or make an effort; slow and relaxed.

situation: A man lies completely horizontal across three living room sofa cushions in broad daylight, watching a television remote control that has fallen just six inches beyond his outstretched fingertips.
subject: the unwillingness to make an effort
brief: A heavy-lidded man lies sprawled horizontally across a living room sofa, completely motionless in bright afternoon sunlight. The television remote control lies on the floor just six inches beyond his fingertips, and he stares down at it with profound reluctance, making no move to reach it.
